about: Prices only some people can get: a company's employees, drivers of a ride-hailing platform. A tariff (ceme-v2's `audience`) or a direct offer (manual.json's `audience`) carrying one of these ids is hidden unless the driver says they belong to it (the `audiences` argument of the tools). Each id: who it is, in en and pt, as the assistant reads it.

uber-driver.en: professional ride-hailing drivers signed in with their Uber Driver account
uber-driver.pt: motoristas profissionais com conta Uber Driver
